ode_path_finding_2026_10_12.why_this_table_exists: The reconstruction table is measured on a near-solved task (bond EXISTENCE F1 0.9962), which compresses differences between variants. This is the same 8 variants on GENERATED geometry.
ode_path_finding_2026_10_12.what_the_ode_path_generated: 64 clouds by integrating the CFM from the noise prior, midpoint/50. The integration is done ONCE and shared by all 8 variants, which is valid because the valence-budget tables are read only by the bond head at decode time (cfm_decoder_yuelbond.py:485, :601) -- the velocity field does not consult them.
THREE_FINDINGS_THAT_DIFFER_FROM_THE_RECO: no_budget is the WORST variant here, not the best-connected one. On reconstruction it scored of_decoded 1.000 (looked perfect); under generation its decode_ratio is 0.0156 -- 1 molecule out of 64. The "perfect connectivity" of the budget-free decoder is an artefact of feeding it real molecules.
The budget is MORE load-bearing under generation: as_shipped decode_ratio 0.0781 vs no_budget 0.0156 is 5x. On reconstruction the same ratio was 1.6x.

The reserve penalty changes MECHANISM. On reconstruction, tightening the reserve collapsed decode_ratio (0.2031 -> 0.0781 -> 0.0625). Under generation, decode_ratio is FLAT at 0.0781 for as_shipped / reserve_1.0 / reserve_2.0, and only connectivity collapses (of_decoded 1.0 -> 0.4 -> 0.0, n_frags 1.0 -> 2.4 -> 7.4). Withholding budget now fragments the molecule instead of breaking sanitisation.
HARD_LIMITS_ON_THIS_TABLE: ABSOLUTE VALUES ARE NOT USABLE. as_shipped decode_ratio here is 0.0781, while the same metric on cfm_fullcorpus_2026_10_10 (epoch 10) via wf_cfm_decode_dump_smiles.py is 0.344 -- a 4.4x gap. Two different checkpoints (cfm_objective_terms epoch 5 vs cfm_fullcorpus epoch 10) and n=64 is too small. Only the RELATIVE ordering across the 8 variants carries information.
n=64 clouds, one seed, one checkpoint.
decoded counts are 1 to 5 molecules per variant, so of_decoded is estimated on single digits for the tightest reserves.
ode_path_finding_2026_10_12.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not show that as_shipped is optimal under generation either -- the reserve variants tie it on decode_ratio here, and n is far too small to separate them. A decision needs the full-corpus checkpoint and several hundred clouds.
